title: Korban services after the 2026 disruption: oversight, refunds and 2027 preparations
asked: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim asked whether MUIS will review the operating model for korban services in Singapore, introduce a licensing or accreditation framework for operators, and set service standards for local operators.
response: Mr Zaqy Mohamad said MUIS was told on 21 May of a delay in 400 livestock arriving, which affected korban services at four local mosques because a local vendor could not get Australian export approvals in time. MUIS has reviewed the incident and will strengthen oversight of local operators, especially new vendors, add contractual and operational requirements with clearer service standards and contingency plans, and start preparations six to eight months before Hari Raya Haji. The Salam SG Korban 2027 Committee will be formed in September, and The Meat Brothers has assured MUIS it will settle all refunds by early August.

key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: was informed of a delay in the arrival of 400 livestock, which affected local korban services at four local mosques

key_points.quote: a local korban vendor was unable to secure the necessary export approvals from the Australian authorities in time

key_points.quote: MUIS will strengthen oversight of local korban operators, particularly for new vendors

key_points.quote: MUIS will introduce stronger contractual and operational requirements, including clearer service standards, contingency plans and obligations

key_points.quote: Engagements with mosques and korban vendors will now start six to eight months before Hari Raya Haji

key_points.quote: we can consider them, but we will need to look at how they can be incorporated into our processes

key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: The Meat Brothers is a new operator who is not so familiar with the environment

left_open: Whether a formal licensing or accreditation framework for korban operators will be introduced.
What performance measures for vendors, beyond timeliness, will be used to uphold service standards.
supplementary: Oversight and performance standards for vendors, refunds to affected participants, and livestock sourcing and export permits.
